why: Searches found the conjecture still described as open/unproven; a November 2025 arXiv preprint proposes a 'Generalized Elliott-Halberstam Conjecture for Shifted Convolutions' (a different, stronger statement) and other hits are applications assuming EH or unrelated distribution results, none of which improve the conjecture's own level-of-distribution bound (theta < 1).
queries: Elliott-Halberstam conjecture Wikipedia level of distribution 2024 2025 status

found.title: A Generalized Elliott-Halberstam Conjecture Implying the Twin Prime Hypothesis
found.note: Proposes a distinct, generalized variant (GEH-2) for shifted convolutions of the von Mangoldt function; not a result on the original conjecture as stated.
